opt.title: ClearFlow · Settings
opt.useJev: Use Jev to check replies the local rules can't classify
opt.dup: The same line from several accounts
opt.sloganHint: Replies you mark as spam help identify identical or similar content. Your 10 most recent marks are also sent to TypeSafe as examples with the comments being checked.
opt.confirmForgetAllText: This can't be undone. Similar replies may stop being hidden.
opt.abuseHint: Hides insults and personal attacks, not criticism of ideas. Choose Relaxed if too many normal replies are hidden.
opt.sexualHint: Explicit descriptions, sexual slang, porn links and hookup offers count; tasteful talk about relationships, sexual health information and swearing used for emphasis don't. Coded slang isn't always recognized.
opt.imagesHint: Check images in replies on X, Reddit and RedNote for ads, QR codes and sexual content, including replies with no text. Images are resized to 768 px before being sent to Jev, using about 1,000–2,000 extra tokens each. Image checking is experimental and less accurate than text checking. Enabling it requires permission to access images on these sites.
opt.imagesDenied: Image access wasn't granted, so image checking is still off. Turn “Check images in replies” on again and choose “Allow” in the browser prompt.
opt.imagesNeedTs: Add a TypeSafe key under Advanced first (OpenRouter doesn't pass images on yet).
opt.recThreshold: Threshold on posts asking for recommendations
opt.bannerRatio: Show the “mostly bots” notice when the share of spam in the first replies exceeds
opt.cacheMB: Local cache limit for filtering results (Jev), in MB
opt.txCacheMB: Local cache limit for translations, in MB
opt.cacheStats: Local cache: filtering results about {mb} MB ({n} entries), translations about {txmb} MB ({txn} entries).
opt.savedRejudge: Saved. Open pages will re-check with the new settings.
opt.keyOk: Connected ({model}). Promotion score for the sample “{sample}”: {score}.
opt.txLang: Translations follow the site's display language. On Hacker News, or when the site doesn't specify a language, they use your browser's language.
opt.fallback: Fallback model (used when the main one fails; can be left empty)
opt.modelHint: Uses GPT-6 Luna by default, with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash as the fallback if it fails. Only models that allow reasoning to be disabled are supported.
opt.txThreshold: Retranslate X and YouTube caption translations scoring below
opt.confirmClear: Clear all stats, records of hidden replies and your corrections? This can't be undone. (The spam you marked is deleted separately in its list above.)
set.bannerRatio: Spam share in the first replies
set.errModel: {name} should look like vendor/model, e.g. openai/gpt-6-luna.

pop.alert.badKey: Your TypeSafe key isn't working, so replies can't be checked

pop.alert.orBadKey: Your OpenRouter key isn't working, so translation has stopped
pop.hereCleanTx: This page: nothing to hide, {tx} translated.
pop.hereOther: This page isn't supported. On X, filtering works on replies, other people's profiles and search results. Translation also works on Home and post pages.
opt.foldHint: These rules apply to all sites by default. Select a site above to customize its rules. You can open hidden content and correct mistakes on its notice bar.
opt.spamHint: Detects bot spam, unsolicited promotions and ads disguised as ordinary comments. Stricter settings hide more content but may also hide more normal replies by mistake.
opt.custom: Using a custom value, {v} (change it under Advanced).
opt.m1Hint: The reply @-mentions an account that hasn't appeared in the thread, has no image or video, and its text is no longer than {n} Chinese characters (about {m} letters in alphabetic scripts).
opt.dupHint: The same line (identical apart from emoji, at least as long as 6 Chinese characters, about 24 letters) posted by several accounts under one post within 6 hours. Applies to that post only.
opt.fillerHint: Short replies with only praise, agreement, thanks or “+1”, and no images or links. They’re hidden; a line at the top of the comments shows them again.
opt.translateFillHint: On an X post page: when X translated the post but not the author's own replies (follow-ups, thread posts), translate those too, with a way back to the original. Needs only the OpenRouter key.
opt.orHint: Filtering (TypeSafe's Jev model) and translation both go through OpenRouter, billed by usage.
opt.cost: This month: filtering {jev}, translation {or}. Based on the past 7 days, estimated monthly cost: {month}.
opt.fact1: Replies the local rules already identify as spam are not sent to TypeSafe.
opt.fact2: Comment text (up to 600 characters), the commenter’s name and handle, the post’s first 400 characters and its author details are sent through OpenRouter (openrouter.ai) to TypeSafe for scoring, or straight to TypeSafe (api.typesafe.ai) if you added a TypeSafe key. Results are cached for up to 7 days to reduce repeat requests.
opt.fact3: Translation: for posts X has translated, the original and Grok's translation are sent to Jev for scoring the same way. Text that needs retranslating or translating (including on Reddit, YouTube, RedNote and Hacker News) is sent to OpenRouter (openrouter.ai), which passes it to the translation model (OpenAI by default, DeepSeek as fallback; changeable under Advanced).
opt.fact4: Keys, stats, corrections, marked spam and caches are stored in this browser. Scores are cached for up to 7 days; translations expire after 30 days without use.
opt.fact5: With image checking enabled, resized images in replies are also sent to TypeSafe.
opt.m1MaxLen: Length limit for "short replies that only @ a stranger" (1 = one Chinese character or about 4 letters)
opt.m1: Short replies that only @ a stranger
pop.hereOtherReddit: This page isn't supported. On Reddit, filtering and translation work on posts, feeds and search results.
pop.hereOtherHN: This page isn't supported. On Hacker News, ClearFlow hides abusive and sexual comments and translates titles, posts and comments.
pop.hereOtherYT: This page isn't supported. On YouTube, ClearFlow filters video comments and translates titles, descriptions and comments.
pop.hereOtherXHS: This page isn't supported. On RedNote, ClearFlow filters comments and translates titles, notes and comments.
pop.unsupportedHint: ClearFlow works only on these sites:
pop.reload: Reload this page for it to take effect.
opt.foldOn.x: Replies under posts, and posts on other people's profiles and in search results.
opt.foldOn.reddit: Comments under posts, plus posts in feeds, subreddits and search results.
opt.foldOn.hn: Comments on post pages, for abuse and sexual content only. Project announcements and source links are common on Hacker News and can be mistaken for spam, so automatic spam filtering is off. Abuse filtering is also more conservative.
opt.txOn.x: Enhances X's own translations on Home, profiles, search results and post pages: poor ones are redone and replaced, labelled “Improved translation”, and you can switch back to Grok's version anytime. On post pages, author replies X skipped are translated too. Posts X doesn't translate are left as they are. Needs only the OpenRouter key.
opt.txOn.reddit: Titles, posts and comments in another language are translated in place. You can show the original anytime. Needs only the OpenRouter key.
opt.txOn.yt: Video titles, descriptions and comments in another language are translated in place, and you can show the original anytime. Comments YouTube can translate use YouTube's own translation first. Needs only the OpenRouter key.
opt.txOn.xhs: Card titles, notes and comments in another language are translated in place. You can show the original anytime. Needs only the OpenRouter key.
opt.txOn.hn: Titles in lists, and posts and comments on post pages, are translated in place. You can show the original anytime. Needs only the OpenRouter key.

opt.captionConvert: Show Traditional Chinese captions in Simplified Chinese
opt.captionConvertHint: When YouTube is set to Simplified Chinese, converts Traditional Chinese captions (Taiwan or Hong Kong) to simplified characters and mainland vocabulary. Skipped if the video already has Simplified Chinese captions. Runs locally at no cost.
opt.captionFixHint: Improves YouTube's auto-translated captions. For Simplified Chinese, uses manually created Chinese captions when available. Otherwise, TypeSafe checks the translation and your model retranslates poor captions as you watch. Only the parts you watch are translated. Needs only the OpenRouter key.
